description: ICU admission, at general_table.admissiontime (date-shifted). HiRID covers stays in the intensive care unit only; the code keeps the name used by earlier releases of this ETL.
source: hirid-docs: general_table.admissiontime, one patientid per ICU admission (https://hirid.intensivecare.ai/structure-of-the-published-data, https://hirid.intensivecare.ai/data-details); messy.yaml general_table/admission

description: ICU discharge, placed at the stay's last observation (latest observation_tables.datetime) because HiRID records no discharge time; the code keeps the name used by earlier releases of this ETL.
source: messy.yaml general_table/discharge; DESIGN_DECISIONS.md D8; README Data notes (issue #4)

description: Pseudo date of birth: general_table.admissiontime minus general_table.age in years. HiRID reports age in bins (ages above 89 are set to 90), so the date can be off by several years.
source: hirid-docs: general_table.age, age at admission, above 89 set to 90 (https://hirid.intensivecare.ai/structure-of-the-published-data); messy.yaml general_table/birth; DESIGN_DECISIONS.md D8

description: Death in the ICU: general_table.discharge_status, the ICU (not hospital) discharge status, is not 'alive'; a missing status is not counted. Placed at the stay's last observation because HiRID records no time of death.
source: hirid-docs: general_table.discharge_status, ICU discharge alive or dead (https://hirid.intensivecare.ai/structure-of-the-published-data); messy.yaml general_table/death; DESIGN_DECISIONS.md D8
